 Atlético Madrid vs Barcelona, La Liga: Match Thread, Live Updates
 Join us for another Barcelona La Liga adventure!
 by Renato Gonçalves Updated Nov 8, 2026, 6:48 PM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 Photo by David Ramos/Getty Images Getty Images Renato Gonçalves Renato Goncalves is the deputy manager of Barca Blaugranes and has been writing for the site since all the way back in 2014. He’s a massive sports fan and has been crazy about Barcelona ever since Rivaldo scored that bicycle kick in 2001. WELCOME TO THE ESTADIO METROPOLITANO !!! The impressive home of Atlético Madrid in the Spanish capital is the site of a gigantic La Liga clash between the hosts and Barcelona, who come into this one looking for a statement win in the title race. This should be all kinds of fun, and you’re welcome to join us to follow and comment all the action. Vamos !
 LINEUPS
 BARCELONA 
 Starting XI : Joan; Fariñas, Cubarsí, Martín, Cancelo; Fermín, Bernal, Pedri; Yamal, Raphinha, Gordon (4-3-3)
 Substitutes : Szczesny (GK), Livakovic (GK), Christensen, Campos, Eric, Balde, De Jong, Gavi, Tunkara, Adeyemi, Jesus, Hamza
 ATLÉTICO MADRID 
 Starting XI : Oblak; Llorente, Pubill, Hancko, Grimaldo; Simeone, Barrios, Koke, Baena; Lee, Álvarez (4-4-2)
 Substitutes : Musso (GK), Le Normand, Romeo, Domínguez, Martínez, Mendoza, Johnny, Ortiz, Hjulmand, Sorloth, Lookman, David
 MATCH INFO
 Competition/Round : 2026-27 La Liga , Matchday 12
 Date/Time : Sunday, November 8, 2026, 9pm CET/WAT (Barcelona & Nigeria), 8pm GMT (UK), 3pm ET, 12pm PT (USA), 1.30am IST (India, Monday)
 Venue : Estadio Metropolitano , Madrid, Spain
 Referee : Javier Alberola Rojas
 VAR : Javier Iglesias Villanueva
 HOW TO WATCH
 On TV : ESPN Deportes (USA), Premier Sports 1 (UK), SuperSport (Nigeria), Movistar (Spain), others 
 Online : ESPN+ (USA), Premier Sports Player (UK), FanCode (India), Movistar+ (Spain), others 
 Matchday Thread Rules
 We don’t have a lot of rules here, but there are a few things to keep in mind when joining our matchday threads:
 Even if the referee sucks or we lose the game, watch the swearing . It’s just unnecessary. Also, don’t discuss illegal streaming links . Those who do it will be warned, and those who post links will be instantly banned . Finally, be nice to each other . This is a Barcelona community and we don’t need to offend one another.
 Have fun with the game! Forever and ever, no matter the competition, VISCA EL BARÇA!
